story.title: Court Ruling Allows Russia to Compete in Ice Hockey Championships
story.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport has ruled that Russian teams must be permitted to participate in international ice hockey tournaments, reversing a previous ban imposed by the IIHF following Russia's invasion of Ukraine. This decision reinstates Russia's eligibility for the world championships.

related_stories.summary: Iran's supreme leader has warned the United States and Israel against launching new attacks, coinciding with legislative polls in both countries that may influence the ongoing conflict with Iran. The warning comes as diplomatic efforts are being made to resolve tensions, with Qatari mediators involved in discussions.

related_stories.summary: Thousands of protesters, including students and workers, have taken to the streets across Italy to voice their concerns over rising living costs and increased military spending. The demonstrations have been fueled by recent school occupations and calls for more funding for education.

related_stories.summary: The Trump administration is considering a potential sale of Patriot missiles to Ukraine, which will now be reviewed by Congress. This decision follows complaints from Ukrainian officials regarding dwindling supplies of interceptor missiles.

related_stories.title: Evacuation Operation Brings Residents from Oleshky to Ukrainian Territory
related_stories.summary: Residents from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have successfully crossed into Ukrainian-held territory following a humanitarian evacuation operation. This operation was facilitated by a localized ceasefire, marking a significant truce amid ongoing conflict. The evacuation comes after intense fighting in Oleshky, which has been under Russian control since 2022, leaving many residents in dire conditions.
